theorem lg_target {k : ℕ} (n : ℕ) (hk0 : k ≠ 0) : ∃ p, Nat.Prime p ∧ n < p ∧ p ≡ 1 [MOD k] := by
  let m := n + 1
  let p := Classical.choose { p : ℕ | Nat.Prime p ∧ p ≥ m }
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hge⟩ := p
  have hge' : p ≥ m := hge
  have hgt : p > n := by exact Nat.lt_of_le_of_gt hge' (Nat.le_refl m)
  have hmod : p % k = 1 := by
    have hk0' : k ≠ 0 := hk0
    have hge_k : p ≥ k := by rw [Nat.le_add_right]; exact Nat.le_refl _
    have hlt : p < k * 1 + 1 := by rw [Nat.add_mul]; exact Nat.lt_add_right _
    have hmod_eq : p % k = p - k * (p / k) := rfl
    have hdiv : p / k = 0 := by
      rw [Nat.div_eq_zero]
      exact Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.le_of_lt (Nat.mul_pos hk0' (Nat.succ_pos' n))) hlt
    rw [hmod_eq, hdiv]
    exact Nat.sub_self k
  exact ⟨p, hp, hgt, hmod⟩
